blocks.title: Calendar for Baxstar's 21' Ice Castle RV Extreme Edition

blocks.text: Step into our 21' RV Extreme Edition Ice Castle—our most spacious luxury sleeper house. With noticeably higher ceilings, arctic insulation, cedar walls, a square bay with fireplace, and a full kitchen and bathroom, this house delivers an elevated cabin-on-ice experience.  This premiere house comes with our most powerful 4800w generator, giving you plenty of juice to safely power electronics and the fireplace.  Perfect for groups up to 6, it offers unmatched space, warmth, and comfort for long days and overnight stays.

Designed to feel like a premium RV on the ice:



 
 Turn key ready

 

 
 6 pre-drilled holes

 

 
 32" Smart TV

 

 
 CD & DVD Play, Stereo

 

 
 Full Kitchenette (microwave, oven, fridge)

 

 
 Rod holders

 

 
 Ice scoop, pliers, scissors, hooks, splitshots

 

 
 4 Rattle Reels

 

 
 Blankets, pillows, sheets available

 

 
 Generator (must purchase gas)

 

 
 Easy parking near the house

 

 
 Close access to Detroit Lakes dining and stores

 



This 21' is easily the most comfortable house in our lineup.

This house is a major step above standard 17' layouts:



 
 🔥 Electric fireplace for warmth and atmosphere

 

 
 🛋️ Dual upgraded leather couches convert to individual beds

 

 
 📏 Higher ceiling height for an open, residential feel

 

 
 ⚡ Massive 4800-watt generator for reliable, quiet power

 

 
 🛏️ Mechanized Queen-size top bunk, hidden from view

 



Everything is designed to feel premium, spacious, and intentional.

This house provides a versatile, roomy sleeping layout, with 5 total beds:​



 
 54" electric lift bed with upper cabinets to conceal the lift system

 

 
 Two 30" front bunks

 

 
 Two 40" rear jack-knife sofas

 Everyone gets a comfortable place to wind down after a day on the ice.

A raised, private bathroom features:



 
 Camper-style toilet

 

 
 Disposable bag liner system for winter use

 

 
 More room and privacy than 17’ houses

 



The extra space is a game changer for families and large groups.
